content.short: Unique cyborg NFTs minted on the Cardano blockchain. Each NFT will have a variety of different items and traits giving each one individuality.
content.description:
BORGZ is the play to earn token for the Battle Borgz online trading card game.

Play-to-earn helps connect users with Battle Borgz on an advanced level. In this Sci-Fi, action and adventure game, players directly participate in battles and demonstrate their skills while exploring the game system.

The most exciting aspect of the $BORGZ token is that the longer you hold your Battle Borgz NFTs, the more $BORGZ you will acquire, as tokens will be automatically sent to wallets with one or more Battle Borgz NFTs every epoch.

Our tokenomics implement layers of Incentive Mechanisms, DeFi Effective Engines and Regulatory Tools in Token Circulation Looping. When this Tokenomics cyclic system is in operation, the increase in demand for token circulation will outpace the supply. This growth engine has been installed in the Battle Borgz tokenomics system to ensure stability and growth for the BORGZ token and game ecosystem as a whole.

Our project will add extra utility to the CNFT space through both gaming and tokenization, our timeline to achieve both of these successfully is Q3 2022.

We believe by this time the CNFT space will have developed immensely, and utilities such as ours will no longer be an added bonus, but a necessity for new projects, so we plan to be among the first projects to implement both gamification and tokenization to a high standard.
